title: Truck-crew replay v2: passage-based abort rule, four populations, leak-free arm (HQ decisions 2/3/6)
supersedes: data/processed/truck_crew_replay_yeongdeok.json (v1, slice-boundary abort rule) — kept as the record, not rewritten
label_ko: 이 화면은 2025년 3월 25일 영덕 산불의 커밋된 예측장(routing_demo_canonical.npz)과 2026-07-24 도로망 스냅샷으로 만든 재생(replay)입니다. 실시간 도구가 아니고, 출동 기록도 아닙니다. 지점은 건물이며 가구가 아닙니다. 규칙과 한계는 docs/truck_crew_replay.md.

inputs.observation: obs_stack of the canonical npz; byte-identical in both files, so the grading clock does not depend on the field

parameters.abort_rule_v2: latest departure d* = min over sampled points of (interpolated cutoff-crossing minute - travel minute to that point); abort minute = d* - 12. Continuous minutes, linear-in-time between the five forecast slices.
parameters.abort_rule_v1: arrival > (earliest slice at which any sampled point reaches the cutoff) - 12. Kept in §4 as the slice-boundary version.

canonical.note: the committed field v1 used; known to be flattered by the 의성·안동 training leak (docs/leakfree_fold.md)

leakfree.note: the leak-free refit (G3/WFG-032), about half the size; a sensitivity arm, NOT the base (HQ decision 6)

canonical.core_credible.label: the credible no-safe-walk nodes (HQ decision 3a; includes the 10-node cluster)

canonical.no_safe_walk.label: every no-safe-walk node in the forecast partition (3b)

canonical.immobile_10pct.label: immobile draw at 0.10 plus the no-safe-walk class (3c, sensitivity)

canonical.immobile_30pct.label: immobile draw at 0.30 plus the no-safe-walk class (3c, sensitivity; this is v1's population)

leakfree.core_credible.label: the credible no-safe-walk nodes (HQ decision 3a; includes the 10-node cluster)

leakfree.no_safe_walk.label: every no-safe-walk node in the forecast partition (3b)

leakfree.immobile_10pct.label: immobile draw at 0.10 plus the no-safe-walk class (3c, sensitivity)

leakfree.immobile_30pct.label: immobile draw at 0.30 plus the no-safe-walk class (3c, sensitivity; this is v1's population)

caveats: buildings are not households; a pickup is a road point, not a door
the leak-free arm is a sensitivity, not the base (HQ decision 6)
the success line is NOT quotable until HQ says so (decision 1)
one pickup per trip; no capacity in persons, no queues, no traffic
영덕 only, one fire, one observation
